### The Pre-Existent Word
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-december-1-2024.html
Passage: John 1:1-2
Points:
- Popular cultural images of Jesus often obscure His true nature revealed in Scripture.
- John opens by establishing Christ's eternality, divine personality, and status as the uncreated Creator.
- The Word is distinct in person from the Father yet completely one with God.
- Every act and teaching in John's Gospel must be viewed through the lens of Jesus' deity.
- Grasping who Christ truly is turns the duty of obedience into heartfelt joy and worship.

### The Life That Is the Light
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-january-27.html
Passage: John 1:4-5
Points:
- Jesus entered human history as light to deliver mankind from sin, death, and darkness.
- As the divine Author of all creation, He initiated a rescue plan to restore His people.
- Christ provides absolute truth and wisdom that break the destructive power of deception.
- No spiritual darkness or bleak circumstance can overcome God's ultimate purposes.
- Followers of Christ are invited to reflect His light and advance His kingdom in the world.
